description: Intent i004 (branch=error-path-commit, snapshot s01) complete. Searched only snapshots/s01: a heuristic line-window scanner over net/ and drivers/net parse/copy-helper call sites (4097 raw windows) followed by deep reads of ~20 regions. 4 medium-confidence findings, all sharing the seed mechanism of a destructive write-side commit or table/peer walk executed before a parse/validation failure aborts the flow: (1) drivers/net/bonding/bond_netlink.c:249-275 bond_changelink — bond_option_arp_ip_targets_clear(bond) wipes the whole ARP monitoring target list before the nested-attribute loop can 'return -EINVAL' on an attribute shorter than sizeof(__be32), leaving the bond with empty arp_targets and an error return, no rollback; partial adds also persist via 'break'. (2) drivers/net/macvlan.c:1554-1597 macvlan_changelink — macvlan_flush_sources and the commit 'vlan->mode = mode' (line 1591) execute before later dev_set_promiscuity/macvlan_changelink_sources failures 'return err/ret', leaving the mode switched and source-MAC table destroyed on a failed netlink request. (3) drivers/net/macvlan.c:1376-1398 macvlan_changelink_sources MACADDR_SET path — unconditional flush then failure of macvlan_hash_add_source returns with an empty/partial source table. (4) drivers/net/wireguard/netlink.c:524-538 wg_set_device — ++wg->device_update_gen, wg->fwmark = nla_get_u32(...) and a full peer-list socket walk (wg_socket_clear_peer_endpoint_src for every peer) commit before set_port() can fail with 'if (ret) goto out' and no rollback at out:. Counter-evidence checked: all are CAP_NET_ADMIN (netns-capable) gated, so impact is partial application/silent state destruction on error rather than memory corruption; verified no restore paths by reading each function and its error labels; quotes verified literal in the reported ranges. 14 candidate sites classified (8 safe with concrete guard evidence — br_netlink multicast knobs, br_vlan_options, devlink sb pool/port_pool/tc_pool_bind set_doits, nexthop rtm_nh_get_timer, bond_options sscanf, rtlwifi h2c; 5 unresolved: vxlan mtu, batman-adv sel_class/orig_interval, br_mdb entry, gtp hashsize, team err — not deeply read before the finalize cutoff). Limitations: setsockopt/ioctl/non-net procfs write paths not systematically scanned; no runtime reproducer; netlink policy tables reasoned from explicit length checks rather than directly inspected.
